name: Elizaphan (son of Parnek)
title: Chieftain from the tribe of Zebulun
summary: Elizaphan, son of Parnek, was the chieftain from the tribe of Zebulun who was appointed to help distribute the land of Canaan among the tribes.

keyEvents.title: Appointed to Distribute the Land
keyEvents.description: Elizaphan, son of Parnek, was appointed as the chieftain of Zebulun to allocate inheritance portions in Canaan.
